description: Which gateway calls happened recently? Returns recent gateway calls (time, app, matched route, status, reason, duration); use it to investigate individual calls across the project rather than gate_get_metrics aggregates or a single gate_get_run_timeline. Newest first, with totals by status and refusal reason for the returned calls. This view never returns bodies, query values or headers. For 24-hour totals and anomaly scores use gate_get_metrics; for a signed export an auditor can check, gate_export_audit_proof; for one run's history, gate_get_run_timeline.

admin_key.description: The project admin key (ga_...). Read it from the .env; never print it.

project_id.description: The project id from project creation on the setup endpoint (/mcp/setup), e.g. p1a2b3...

status.description: Optional: only this HTTP status, e.g. "403"

name: gate_read_audit
title: Read the audit log
